full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photographic portrait crops closely around a young woman's face as she looks down and to the right from within dark cloth. The background is almost entirely black, merging with the fabric that frames the left side and the lower edge, so the face seems to emerge from a deep continuous shadow. Across the upper left, a few short strands of dark hair escape the covering and curl over her forehead. One eye sits near the center-left beneath a strong dark brow; the lowered gaze is visible through a narrow glint on the eye and a soft shadow under the lid. The opposite eye is mostly swallowed by the near-black right side, making the asymmetry of light central to the image. Her nose catches a pale strip of illumination, then falls into shadow at the nostril and beside the cheek. The lips are slightly parted and gently shaded, and the lower face turns back toward darkness beneath the chin. The pale cheek occupies the broadest uninterrupted area of light, its smooth gradation offset by the coarse woven texture of the cloth at left. The crop cuts away the shoulders and any clear setting, allowing the brow, eye, nose, and mouth to determine the frame's rhythm. Soft directional light comes from the upper left and front, revealing the nearer side of the face while the far side and fabric stay dense black; there is no separate visible cast shadow in the background. Fine photographic grain prevents the luminous skin from looking polished, and the tonal transition remains velvety rather than sharply posterized. The overall composition is intimate and somber, balancing a single luminous facial plane against heavy surrounding darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白摄影肖像紧密裁切一名年轻女子的面部，她在深色布料中向右下方垂目。背景几乎全部为黑色，与围住左侧和下画边的布料合为一片连续深影，使面容像从暗处浮出。左上方有几缕短深发从遮盖中逸出，在额前卷起。一只眼位于中央偏左的深眉之下，细小眼中亮光和眼睑下柔影显出低垂的视线。另一只眼大多被右侧近黑暗部吞没，让不对称光线成为图像核心。鼻梁接住一条浅亮光，鼻翼与面颊旁随即沉入阴影。双唇微张、柔和着影，下方面部在下颌以下又转入黑暗。浅色面颊构成最大一片连续亮部，光滑渐层与左侧布料粗纺肌理形成对照。紧密裁切去掉肩部和任何明确场景，让眉、眼、鼻、嘴决定画面节奏。柔和的方向光从左上和前方进入，显露近侧面孔，远侧与织物则保持浓黑；背景里没有单独可见的投影。细微摄影颗粒令发亮肌肤不显抛光，明暗过渡呈丝绒感而非生硬分色。整体构图亲密而阴郁，以一片发亮的脸部平面平衡周围沉重黑暗。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white photograph concentrates soft directional light within a small smooth area surrounded by dense, velvety shadow. Deep blacks merge neighboring shapes, while a narrow sequence of silver-gray planes and tiny highlights carries the form. Fine grain and one coarse woven texture keep the surface physical; the brightest region remains softly graded rather than glossy. Close cropping excludes environmental detail and turns asymmetrical light falloff into the main compositional structure. Edges on the illuminated side stay readable, then disappear gradually into the dark, creating depth without a visible background plane. The overall effect is intimate, restrained, and emotionally heavy, with tonal placement and tactile contrast doing the expressive work.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅黑白摄影把柔和方向光集中在一片小而光滑的区域，周围则是浓密丝绒般阴影。深黑使相邻形状合并，一段狭窄的银灰平面和微小高光承担塑形。细颗粒及一处粗纺肌理使表面有真实质感；最亮区域保持柔和渐层而非光亮抛光。近距离裁切排除环境细节，使不对称的光线衰减成为主要构图结构。受光侧边缘仍可辨，随后逐渐消失在暗处，不依靠可见背景平面也建立纵深。整体效果亲密、克制且情绪沉重，由明度位置和可触的肌理对比承担表达。
theme_en: A close black-and-white portrait of a young woman looking downward from within a dark hood
theme_zh: 年轻女子在深色头巾中低头凝视的黑白近景肖像
name: Dave Heath
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
